name: PEBBLE
description: PEBBLE is a compact, plug-and-play benchmark for evaluating large language model tutors in multi-turn tutoring dialogues, scoring five process-level dimensions grounded in learning sciences, including scaffolding, diagnostic questioning, misconception repair, metacognitive support, and affective support.
reputation: A new benchmark with early-stage adoption, positioned as a compact evaluation for LLM tutors in multi-turn educational dialogue.
notes: Incorporates contamination controls and an overhelping penalty; evaluates tutoring quality across four STEM domains using simulated students.
